g2.why: The text says families were displaced during the Highland Clearances so land could be used for sheep and deer.

g3.why: The text says the first recorded sighting was in 565 AD.

g7.label: 7. Where did selkie legends originate?
g7.why: The text says the selkie legends originated in Orkney and Shetland.

g1.label: 1. "I ___ in Inverness two days earlier"
g1.why: ‘Two days earlier’ signals an action completed before the main story time, so the past perfect is used.

g2.label: 2. "That evening, I ___ by the shore"
g2.why: A background scene-setting action uses the past continuous: ‘was sitting’.

g3.label: 3. "I ___ such complete silence before"
g3.why: A life experience up to that point in the story uses the past perfect.

g4.label: 4. "Suddenly, something ___ the surface"
g4.why: ‘Suddenly’ signals a short, completed action, so the simple past is used.

g5.label: 5. "While I ___ at the ripples..."
g5.why: A background action happening at the same time as another event uses the past continuous.

g6.label: 6. "...stories my grandmother ___ me"
g6.why: An action completed before the main story time (as a child) uses the past perfect.

g7.label: 7. "I ___ up my things and walked back"
g7.why: A sequence of short, completed actions uses the simple past.

g8.label: 8. "'That ___ probably just an otter'"
g8.why: A simple statement about a past event uses the simple past.

g1.label: 1. One of the most ___ populated regions
g1.why: ‘Sparsely populated’ is the fixed collocation for an area with very few people.

g2.label: 2. The landscape is wild and ___
g2.why: ‘Rugged’ describes a landscape with steep mountains and rocky terrain.

g3.label: 3. Families were ___ from their homes
g3.why: The text says families were displaced from their homes during the Clearances.

g4.label: 4. A deep connection to ___ lands
g4.why: ‘Ancestral lands’ describes land connected to a family's past generations.

g5.label: 5. Kelpies are described as ___ spirits
g5.why: The text says kelpies can change their appearance, so they are called shape-shifting spirits.

g6.label: 6. Selkie stories are sad and ___
g6.why: ‘Melancholic’ describes stories dealing with loss, longing and impossible love.

g7.label: 7. Scotland has a rich tradition of ___
g7.why: The text says Scotland has a rich tradition of folklore, with stories of mythical creatures.

g8.label: 8. Highland communities are ___
g8.why: ‘Fragile’ describes communities vulnerable to small changes in population or economy.
